title: Delta scorecard canary for embeddings and ranking
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Implement an automated, change-triggered "delta scorecard" that runs offline embedding + reranker evaluations whenever a config or model artifact changes. The goal is to surface degradations in core metrics (recall@k, precision@k, MRR, nDCG) and a statistical drift score before a rollout progresses beyond canary. This ticket covers: (1) event hooks from model/config registry -> eval pipeline; (2) sampled shadow replays to compute baseline vs candidate deltas; (3) cohort bucketing (domain, query length, customer tier) and per-cohort metrics; (4) statistical significance checks (bootstrap CI and A/B MDE thresholds); (5) threshold-based policy that can mark canary as failed and attach a rollback suggestion to the rollout; (6) persistent scorecards and a lightweight Grafana dashboard and alerts. Emphasis on fast turnaround (<30m for small models, <2h for large full-batch runs) and clear human-readable summaries for PM/SE review.
acceptance_criteria: On any registered model or config change, the eval pipeline triggers automatically with metadata linked to the change (commit/model-id/config-id)
Produces delta table with recall@1/5/10, precision@1/5/10, MRR, nDCG, and sample counts for baseline and candidate for each cohort
Computes bootstrap 95% CIs and flags statistically significant degradations based on configurable MDEs
Drift score computed per cohort using embedding distance distribution shift + KL divergence of top-k label distributions
If any critical cohort exceeds configured degradation thresholds, pipeline emits a canary-failed marker consumed by rollout service; a follow-up alert and GitHub issue template are created
Dashboard tile available in Grafana with last 14 days of scorecards and a drilldown per-change, plus a permalink in the change event
PR with unit and integration tests merged and e2e run in staging demonstrating a simulated model delta being detected
Run-time SLA: small quick-probe sample completes within 30 minutes; full sampled evaluation completes within 2 hours for typical production datasets
updates: 2026-02-25: Triage and scope aligned with PM/Research. Candidate approach: two-phase evaluation (quick-probe + full cohort run).

2026-03-04: Decided to separate embedding-only signal (distributional shift) from reranker-quality signal (rank metrics) to avoid noisy composites.
2026-03-08: Implemented baseline ingestion job and initial delta computation; smoke tests on staging dataset show recall drop detected in synthetic candidate.
2026-03-10: Hooked event emitter from model-registry to pipeline; observed trigger events in dev cluster. Working on CI for statistical tests.
